name: Di Sebalik Jubah
overview:
It tells the story of two influential Islamic sisters, Layla and Amina, who are adored by many for their robed image and generous nature.

The two lead Laymina Shares, a charitable foundation that has successfully gained the trust of the community to the point of mobilizing thousands of followers to donate through various campaigns.

However, the success of the fundraiser began to be questioned when allegations arose that some of the donations were not channeled to the target group, but were instead used for personal gain.
